notablePrerequisites: You have at least one red card in hand.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Horde Ambusher.
When Horde Ambusher dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Horde Ambusher from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
When Horde Ambusher enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Horde Ambusher's morph ability by revealing a red card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.
